skills.does: Lift the fenced code snippets out of a markdown document.
examples: get the code blocks from this readme
extract just the js blocks
pull an untagged code block

skills.does: Pull every money amount out of a text, with its currency.
examples: get the amounts from this invoice line
find the prices in this sentence
extract amounts with thousands separators

skills.does: Pull the dates already written in a block of text back out of it.
examples: find the dates in this text
extract dates written out in words
are there any dates here

skills.does: List the email addresses written somewhere in a text.
examples: get the emails out of this: contact ana@example.com or sales@shop.co.uk
find email addresses in this signature block
pull the addresses, keeping duplicates

skills.does: Gather the #tags used in a post.
examples: get the hashtags from this post
find the tags in this caption
extract hashtags ignoring a hex colour

skills.does: Find the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in a server log.
examples: get the ip addresses from this log
find the ips in these lines
extract ipv6 addresses

skills.does: Pull the bulleted or numbered list items out of a document.
examples: get the list items from this note
extract the numbered steps
pull the items from a nested list

skills.does: Gather the @handles somebody was tagged as.
examples: who is mentioned in this post
get the handles from this thread
extract mentions but not the email address

skills.does: Break text into overlapping runs of n words or characters — two-word runs, bigrams, trigrams.
examples: get the bigrams from this sentence
trigrams of this text
single word ngrams

skills.does: Take the plain figures out of a text, thousands separators and decimals handled.
examples: get the numbers from: we sold 1,250 units at £3.99 each
pull the figures out of this line
extract numbers including negatives

skills.does: Spot the phone numbers you could dial in a signature or footer.
examples: find the phone numbers in this text
extract phone numbers with country codes
are there any phone numbers here

skills.does: Pull every clock time out of a text and give each in 24-hour form.
examples: get the times from this message
find the clock times in this line
extract times written with a dot

skills.does: List the web addresses appearing in a block of text.
examples: get the links from: see https://example.com/docs and www.other.org
extract the url, ignore the full stop
find links in a markdown line

skills.does: Find the longest word in a text — the biggest word, and any that tie with it.
examples: what is the longest word in this sentence
find the longest word
longest three words in this line

skills.does: Find entries in a list that are nearly the same as each other.
examples: find near duplicates in this list
are any of these the same
spot duplicate entries ignoring case and punctuation

skills.does: Scan text for personal or sensitive data and report what was found and where, leaving the text unchanged.
examples: check this for personal data
does this contain a card number
is there any pii here

skills.does: Flag swear words in text against a word list.
examples: check this for swearing
is there profanity in this text
flag rude words

skills.does: Join the lines of a text into one line, separated by a delimiter you choose.
examples: join these lines with commas
turn this list into a comma separated line
join the lines with a pipe

skills.does: Pull the most distinctive words out of a document.
examples: pull the keywords out of this
what are the main topics here
keywords from this paragraph

skills.does: Judge whether text sounds happy or unhappy, positive or negative.
examples: how positive is this review
score the sentiment of this feedback
is this message positive or negative

skills.does: Hide private details in text — emails, phone numbers, cards — behind placeholders.
examples: redact the personal data in this
mask this card number with stars
partially mask the email

skills.does: Tidy the spacing in a text — collapse runs of spaces, trim the ends, and unify line endings.
examples: tidy up the spacing in this
trim and collapse this text
normalise windows line endings

skills.does: Put a line number in front of each line of a text.
examples: number these lines
add line numbers starting at 10
number lines with a colon

skills.does: Pad text out to a fixed width, aligned left, right or centre.
examples: pad "abc" to 8 characters
right align 42 in 6 columns
centre the word title in 11

skills.does: Estimate the reading age of a passage — reading ease and school grade level.
examples: how hard is this to read
reading level of this sentence
flesch score for a plain paragraph

skills.does: How long a text takes to read or to say aloud, at a words-per-minute rate you set.
examples: how long will this take to read
reading time for a short note
how long to read this out loud at 150 wpm

skills.does: Remove repeated lines from a text, keeping the first time each one appeared.
examples: remove the duplicate lines
dedupe this list keeping the order
remove duplicates ignoring case

skills.does: Strip emoji out of text.
examples: remove the emoji from this
strip emoji out
take the emoji out of this message

skills.does: Strip the common filler words from a text, leaving only the content words.
examples: strip the filler words from this
remove stop words from a search query
strip filler and my own extra words

skills.does: Find and replace text, either literally or with a regular expression.
examples: replace "colour" with "color" in my text
swap all the commas for semicolons
collapse repeated spaces using a regex

skills.does: Reverse a text — by character, by word, or by line.
examples: reverse the word stressed
reverse this text backwards
reverse the word order of the quick brown fox

skills.does: Measure how much two texts overlap by the words they share.
examples: how similar are these two sentences
compare two identical texts
overlap between two unrelated lines

skills.does: Measure how many single-character edits turn one string into another, and how similar that makes them.
examples: how different are kitten and sitting
edit distance between colour and color
how similar are these two names

skills.does: Turn a title into a URL-safe slug — lowercase, hyphens, no accents or punctuation.
examples: make a slug from "Hello, World! A Beginner's Guide"
url slug for "Café Münster — Opening Times"
slugify with underscores: My Blog Post

skills.does: Put the lines of a text in order — alphabetically, numerically, or by length.
examples: sort these lines alphabetically
sort this list z to a
sort these numbers properly

skills.does: Split one line into separate lines wherever a delimiter appears.
examples: split this comma separated list onto lines
break this on semicolons
split a tab separated row

skills.does: Reduce words to their stems so different forms of the same word group together.
examples: stem running runs and runner
reduce these to stems
stem the plural forms

skills.does: Strip the tags out of HTML markup and leave the readable words.
examples:
strip the tags from

Hello world
get the text out of this html
remove tags and decode the entities

skills.does: Turn markdown into plain text, dropping the formatting marks.
examples: strip the markdown from **bold** and *italic*
plain text from this heading
remove the markdown link syntax
